# CWE-250: Execution with Unnecessary Privileges — IaC Detection Guide

---

## Core Weakness Categories to Detect

### 1. **Container/Workload Running as Root or Privileged User**

Containers or workloads configured to run as the root user or with elevated system-level privileges without necessity.

| Attribute / Field | Implication |
|---|---|
| `runAsUser: 0` | Explicitly running as root (UID 0) |
| `runAsNonRoot: false` | Allows root execution |
| `privileged: true` | Full host privilege access |
| `user: root` | Explicit root user assignment |
| `user: ""` *(empty/absent)* | Defaults to root in many runtimes |
| `runAsGroup: 0` | Running under root group |

---

### 2. **Privilege Escalation Allowances**

Configurations that permit a process to escalate its own privileges at runtime.

| Attribute / Field | Implication |
|---|---|
| `allowPrivilegeEscalation: true` | Permits escalation beyond initial privileges |
| `allowPrivilegeEscalation` *(absent)* | Often defaults to `true`, implying escalation risk |
| `no_new_privileges: false` | Allows new privilege acquisition |
| `setuid` / `setgid` bits enabled | Privilege elevation through file execution |

---

### 3. **Excessive Linux Capabilities**

Granting broad or unnecessary Linux kernel capabilities to containers or processes.

| Attribute / Field | Implication |
|---|---|
| `add: ["ALL"]` | Grants all capabilities — maximum privilege |
| `add: ["SYS_ADMIN"]` | Near-root administrative capability |
| `add: ["NET_ADMIN"]` | Full network stack control |
| `add: ["SYS_PTRACE"]` | Ability to inspect/control processes |
| `add: ["DAC_OVERRIDE"]` | Bypass file permission checks |
| `add: ["SETUID"]` / `add: ["SETGID"]` | Allows UID/GID changes |
| `drop` *(absent or empty)* | No capabilities removed; defaults remain |

---

### 4. **Overly Permissive IAM Roles and Policies**

Cloud identity and access management configurations that grant broader permissions than necessary.

| Attribute / Field | Implication |
|---|---|
| `Action: "*"` | Wildcard — grants all actions |
| `Resource: "*"` | Applies to all resources unconditionally |
| `Effect: Allow` + `Action: "*"` | Blanket permission grant |
| `AdministratorAccess` *(policy name)* | Full administrative privileges |
| `PowerUserAccess` *(policy name)* | Near-admin access level |
| `FullAccess` *(policy name suffix)* | Service-wide unrestricted access |
| `NotAction` / `NotResource` *(with Allow)* | Inverse logic, unintentionally broad |
| `Principal: "*"` | Grants access to any identity |
| `roles/owner` / `roles/editor` *(GCP)* | Overly broad project-level roles |

---

### 5. **Service Accounts and Execution Identities with High Privileges**

Workload service accounts or execution identities bound to elevated roles.

| Attribute / Field | Implication |
|---|---|
| `serviceAccountName: default` | Uses default, often over-privileged account |
| `automountServiceAccountToken: true` | Token auto-mounted, accessible to workload |
| `serviceAccount` bound to `cluster-admin` | Cluster-wide administrative access |
| `roleRef: kind: ClusterRole` + broad rules | Cluster-scoped elevated permissions |
| `execution_role_arn` pointing to admin policy | Lambda/function runs with admin rights |
| `task_role_arn` with wildcard permissions | Container task has excessive cloud access |

---

### 6. **Host-Level Resource Sharing**

Configurations that share host namespaces, networking, or storage, effectively elevating process privileges.

| Attribute / Field | Implication |
|---|---|
| `hostPID: true` | Access to host process namespace |
| `hostIPC: true` | Access to host inter-process communication |
| `hostNetwork: true` | Access to host network stack |
| `hostPath` *(volume mounts)* | Direct host filesystem access |
| `mountPath: /` or `/etc` or `/var` | Sensitive host directory mounted |
| `readOnly: false` *(on sensitive mounts)* | Writable access to critical paths |

---

### 7. **Filesystem and Volume Permission Misconfigurations**

Broad or root-level filesystem permissions granted to running services.

| Attribute / Field | Implication |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyRootFilesystem: false` | Writable root filesystem |
| `fsGroup: 0` | Files owned by root group |
| `chmod 777` / `mode: 0777` | World-writable permissions |
| `mode: 0755` on sensitive directories | Unnecessary write/execute scope |

---

### 8. **Database and Service Credentials with Admin Access**

Infrastructure provisioning that assigns administrative database or service credentials to applications.

| Attribute / Field | Implication |
|---|---|
| `username: admin` / `username: root` | Admin-level DB credentials |
| `master_username` used as app credential | Root DB user passed to application |
| `GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES` | Excessive DB-level permissions |
| Connection strings referencing `sa` or `dba` | System administrator DB account usage |

---

### 9. **Missing Security Context / Defaults Inherited**

Absence of explicit security hardening fields, allowing privileged defaults to apply.

| Missing Attribute | Implication |
|---|---|
| `securityContext` *(absent entirely)* | All default privileges apply |
| `capabilities.drop` *(absent)* | No capability reduction applied |
| `runAsNonRoot` *(absent)* | Root execution not prevented |
| `readOnlyRootFilesystem` *(absent)* | Writable filesystem by default |
| `allowPrivilegeEscalation` *(absent)* | Escalation permitted by default |

---

## Summary of High-Signal Keywords

```
privileged, runAsUser: 0, root, ALL capabilities, hostPID, hostIPC,
hostNetwork, allowPrivilegeEscalation, Action: "*", Resource: "*",
AdministratorAccess, cluster-admin, automountServiceAccountToken,
hostPath, readOnlyRootFilesystem: false, no_new_privileges: false,
SYS_ADMIN, DAC_OVERRIDE, fsGroup: 0, master_username, GRANT ALL
```

---

## Detection Strategy Summary

| Detection Focus | Risk Signal |
|---|---|
| Root/privileged execution | Violates least-privilege principle directly |
| Wildcard IAM permissions | Grants more access than any task requires |
| Absent security context | Implicit elevated defaults apply |
| Host namespace sharing | Breaks container isolation boundary |
| Admin service accounts | Entire workload operates with admin identity |
| Excessive capabilities | Kernel-level privileges granted unnecessarily |

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

privileged_true_names := {"privileged", "hostpid", "hostipc", "hostnetwork", "automountserviceaccounttoken", "allowprivilegeescalation"}

security_false_names := {"runasnonroot", "readonlyrootfilesystem", "no_new_privileges"}

root_numeric_names := {"runasuser", "runasgroup", "fsgroup"}

root_user_values := {"root", "admin", "sa", "dba"}

dangerous_capabilities := {"ALL", "SYS_ADMIN", "NET_ADMIN", "SYS_PTRACE", "DAC_OVERRIDE", "SETUID", "SETGID"}

wildcard_iam_names := {"action", "resource", "principal", "notaction", "notresource"}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == privileged_true_names[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == true
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Configuration enables elevated or unnecessary privileges. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == security_false_names[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == false
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Security hardening flag disabled, permitting elevated privileges. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == root_numeric_names[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Integer"
    attr.value.value == 0
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Process or filesystem running under root user/group (UID/GID 0). (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == {"user", "username", "master_username"}[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    lower(attr.value.value) == root_user_values[_]
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Process or service configured to run with a privileged user account. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == "add"
    attr.value.ir_type == "Array"
    cap := attr.value.value[_]
    cap.ir_type == "String"
    upper(cap.value) == dangerous_capabilities[_]
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Dangerous Linux capability granted to container. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == wildcard_iam_names[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    attr.value.value == "*"
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Wildcard IAM permission grants unrestricted access. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == wildcard_iam_names[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Array"
    item := attr.value.value[_]
    item.ir_type == "String"
    item.value == "*"
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Wildcard IAM permission in array grants unrestricted access. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)(administratoraccess|poweruseraccess|fullaccess|cluster-admin|roles/owner|roles/editor)", attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Overly permissive IAM policy or role assigned. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == "serviceaccountname"
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    lower(attr.value.value) == "default"
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Default service account used, which may have excessive permissions. (CWE-250)"
    }
}
